morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为完整人名使用，不作马来语词缀拆分；英语通常读作两个音节，标准书写首字母大写。数据包未提供音节和Jawi，保留null。

senses.zh_definition: 贝蒂：英语女性人名，常为Elizabeth的昵称，也可作为独立名字。
senses.en_definition: Betty, a feminine given name commonly used as a familiar form of Elizabeth.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan dalam bahasa Inggeris, lazimnya nama panggilan bagi Elizabeth dan juga digunakan sebagai nama sendiri.
senses.nuances: 本义为专有名词，不是具有固定普通词义的马来语词。规范写法为Betty；不能仅凭小写语料判断其一定是人名，也不能据此补造马来语义项。以下搭配为自然称名表达，不代表具有统计证据的固定搭配。[名字资料](https://www.behindthename.com/name/betty)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报：介绍会议主持人
dual_scenarios.ms: Puan Betty akan mempengerusikan mesyuarat pada petang ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 贝蒂女士将主持今天下午的会议。
dual_scenarios.en: Ms Betty will chair this afternoon's meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Betty sudah tiba di kafe?
dual_scenarios.en: Has Betty arrived at the café yet?

messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tunggu kat dalam. Jom masuk.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah tiba dan sedang menunggu di dalam. Mari kita masuk.

messages.en: Yes, she's waiting inside. Let's go in.

etymology.historical_story: Betty developed in English as an affectionate form of Elizabeth, through the shortened form Bet and the familiar ending -y. Such household names can eventually become independent given names. Its appearance in a Malay sentence can therefore reflect an ordinary reference to a person, rather than a new Malay vocabulary item. [Etymology reference](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Betty)
